leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a binary tree data structure using JavaScript objects and arrays
Implement a recursive traversal algorithm to explore all root-to-leaf paths
Initialize and update a running sum variable during tree traversal
Manipulate path data by pushing and popping node values during recursion
Apply base case logic to identify leaf nodes and validate path sums
Integrate the path sum algorithm into a complete function that returns boolean results
Configure test cases with different tree structures and target sums
